Asset type: standalone production mascot logo for PACE, an AI agent workspace.
Primary request: Design ONE original adorable white puppy HEAD ONLY as a distinctive brand icon. Reference design language: bold black rounded hand-drawn contour, sparse expressive face, white filled interior, true transparent exterior, playful premium open-source software mascot. Original character identity: asymmetrical side-swept three-lobed tuft, one small triangular folded ear and one soft hanging ear, rounded slightly squarish cheeks, two solid oval eyes, little triangular nose, small closed off-center smile. No text, no letters, no wordmark, no collar, no accessories, no body, no background, no shadow, no watermark. Exterior genuinely transparent; white face stays opaque.

avatars.constructionPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: Digital Twin feature mascot icon for PACE, a personal AI-agent workspace.
BRAND RULE: preserve the supplied reference's brand language: a cute WHITE floppy-eared puppy with thick rounded BLACK hand-inked contours, simple black oval eyes, triangular black nose, swept soft fur tuft, playful friendly expression, flat 2D shapes. This is our established brand. Do not change to another breed, a realistic dog, geometric emblem, wireframe, polygon art, 3D render, robot or hologram. The reference is for CHARACTER IDENTITY and LINE STYLE, not for its static frontal pose.
BUSINESS MEANING: the user defines their own work background and speaking style, and the AI counterpart answers in their personal role. Show one identity appearing as a real self and its friendly digital self.
NEW COMPOSITION: draw TWO newly posed compact upper-body puppies, same recognizable puppy identity, back-to-back in a playful compact intertwined arrangement. The left puppy turns in a TRUE THREE-QUARTER LEFTWARD view, nose clearly pointing LEFT, small happy smile, one forepaw placed against chest like "me". The right puppy turns in a TRUE THREE-QUARTER RIGHTWARD view, nose clearly pointing RIGHT, one forepaw raised in a small welcoming speaking gesture, friendly slightly open mouth. Their shoulders/back contours overlap gently through the center to form a flowing S-shaped curve, as two outward-facing silhouettes of one identity. Faces look in OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. Left and right poses are newly drawn with perspective and different expression, NOT two scaled copies of the frontal reference. BOTH puppies keep WHITE opaque fur and strong BLACK contours. Distinguish the digital counterpart ONLY by a tiny sky-blue neckerchief and 2 small sky-blue square flecks beside its outside shoulder. No extra jewelry or props.
Keep heads very large and bodies/paws very small for readability; the two heads occupy upper two-thirds of icon. One unified simple silhouette, minimal detail, compact, not a scene. Clear left-bend-right flow. Similar optical size on both sides. Make the pairing charming and polished and visually balanced, fitting the existing PACE puppy family.
Square composition fills 80% canvas with at least 9% clear outer margin. All ears and paws fully inside. Truly transparent exterior, solid opaque WHITE fur interiors. Thick smooth BLACK round-ended strokes. Flat BLACK, WHITE and one small SKY BLUE accent only. No gradients, shading, glow, ground, shadow, text, words, numbers, letters, watermark, circle frame, hats, glasses, monocles, circuit patterns, duplicated front-facing head icons, or robotic eyes.
